title: The Eternal Weapons (WIP)
description: An unfinished lil mod that adds craftable, late-game weapons into Minecraft.
body:
Welcome to the most dumb and unfinished mod I've ever made, which is litreally just here to fill my website with mods!

Eh, if you want ridiculously overpowerered and buggy late-game weapons, download it.

## **Features**

- Red Diamond Ore, a new and rare ore that drops Red Diamonds
- Red Diamonds, an ingredient for crafting the weapons
- Broken Eternal Sword, a sword doing 9 attack damage
- Eternal Sword, repaired and stronger, doing 16 attack damage
- Eternal Axe, doing 20 attack damage, with a long cooldown
- Eternal Bow, shoots regular arrows but increases thier damage massively
- Eternal Trident (very buggy) Does 17 attack damage and instantly comes back to you (works best in single-player!)

**Made by FoxiMakesMods**
